title: Boring, uninspired boxes these days that lag long behind their related movie releases.
text: In the past I got a box with socks in it before. I got another with a pint glass. I got one with a plastic toy. The last couple years its just been the same box with a shirt, pin, decal and 2 figures. Worse, the production woes since the pandemic have seriously lagged their timeliness. I just got Ant-Man Quadramania  box a couple weeks ago almost 2 months after the movie hit theaters. It was a snoozer of a movie and box so I returned it like I have been about half the boxes over the last year or more. It would be refreshing to have something besides a tee shirt in one of these.
label: neutral
